description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：
- zh：中文
- en：英文

默认：zh
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default: zh

descriptions.zh:
关于主域名和子域名级别，参见：
<props="china">[域名级别](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39803.html?spm=a2c4g.2357293.0.0.211f41ffUR1cPb)。 如输入`www.abc.com`，则输出abc.com。</props>
<props="intl">[域名级别](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/faq-detail/39803.htm)。 如输入`www.abc.com`，则输出abc.com。</props>
descriptions.en:
For more information about primary and subdomain name levels, see
<props="china">[Domain name levels](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39803.html?spm=a2c4g.2357293.0.0.211f41ffUR1cPb). For example, if you enter `www.abc.com`, the output is abc.com.</props>
<props="intl">[Domain name levels](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/faq-detail/39803.htm). For example, if you enter `www.abc.com`, the output is abc.com.</props>
